objective: Test whether contemporaneously FX-normalized disagreement across Binance BTC/ETH USDT, BUSD, USDC and FDUSD spot quote markets contains causal direction or exhaustion information for a single-slot USDT perpetual account after realistic costs.

markets.signal_source: Official Binance monthly spot archives for BTC/ETH quoted in USDT, BUSD, USDC and FDUSD, plus exact completed stablecoin-USDT conversion bars
markets.execution_proxy: Official Binance USD-M BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT perpetual bars and funding during initial screen; any survivor requires later Bybit-normalized replay

causal_features: completed-bar volume-weighted non-USDT synthetic-price dislocation versus direct USDT spot
completed-bar non-USDT versus USDT taker-flow gap
completed-bar non-USDT consensus return minus direct-USDT return
completed-bar route dispersion and stablecoin conversion flow
route-composition change as a hard segment boundary

position_exit_contract.quote_consensus_catchup: Exit at the next exact open after completed dislocation convergence, flow reversal, route-composition change, data gap or adverse stop.
position_exit_contract.usdt_isolation_reversal: Exit at the next exact open after completed cross-quote lead closure, flow reversal, route-composition change, data gap or adverse stop.
position_exit_contract.quote_share_migration: Exit at the next exact open after completed migration/lead state ends, flow reversal, route-composition change, data gap or adverse stop.
position_exit_contract.evaluation_boundary: Mark to the final available perpetual close and include liquidation cost only for account NAV measurement; this is not a strategy exit rule.

execution.entry: next exact 15-minute perpetual open with no forward fill
execution.exit: state-defined next exact open or adverse ATR stop; stop-first within a bar
execution.daily_growth_denominator: all UTC calendar days in the evaluated interval

conditional_opening_rule: Download and evaluate 2024 only if at least one preregistered candidate passes every 2022-2023 development gate. Freeze the survivor with highest 24-bps development geometric daily growth before requesting 2024.
exclusions: generic spot-perpetual price leadership without quote-market fragmentation
stablecoin directional trading or depeg speculation as the traded asset
